usdRate.sourceName: BSP Selected Economic and Financial Indicators (30 October 2026)
usdRate.note: Peso per US dollar, closing rate on 29 October 2026 (October 1-29 average 63.06).

inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: headline inflation 7.2% year on year in September 2026 (6.1% in August); PSA site returned HTTP 403. The BSP indicators sheet gives a January-September 2026 average of 5.4%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BSP inflation target 2-4%; CPI 2021-2025 average about 4.1% (BSP indicators sheet)
inflation_projection.note: The BSP targets 3% plus or minus one point, but inflation averaged about 4.1% in 2021-2025 and is running above target in 2026, so we plan with the top of the band, 4%.

policy_rate.sourceName: BSP Selected Economic and Financial Indicators (30 October 2026)
policy_rate.note: Monetary Board raised the Target RRP rate by 50 basis points to 5.50% effective 23 October 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: Searched BSP statistics (deposit rate tables blocked) and large bank rate pages (not reachable): no current typical savings rate found; large banks have historically paid well under 1% on regular savings.

fdr_3m_rate.note: BSP time deposit rates by tenor could not be retrieved (data files blocked, HTTP 403) and bank rate pages were not reachable; the BSP average for all time deposit maturities is in bank_deposit_avg_rate.

fdr_1y_rate.note: BSP time deposit rates by tenor could not be retrieved (data files blocked, HTTP 403) and bank rate pages were not reachable; the BSP average for all time deposit maturities is in bank_deposit_avg_rate.

dps_rate.note: Pag-IBIG MP2 (government 5-year voluntary savings with flexible monthly payments) declares a yearly dividend, but the Pag-IBIG site blocked access (verification screen) so the latest rate could not be read.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BSP Selected Economic and Financial Indicators (30 October 2026)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average bank interest rate on time deposits, all maturities, for the week ending 7 October 2026 (January-September 2026 average 3.72%). Savings deposits pay much less.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Retail Treasury Bonds (RTBs) are sold to individuals by the Bureau of the Treasury, but the Treasury site returned empty pages and no current RTB coupon could be confirmed.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BSP Selected Economic and Financial Indicators (30 October 2026)

tbond_5y_rate.note: No source for the current 5-year benchmark yield was reachable (BVAL and Bureau of the Treasury pages blocked or empty).

tbond_10y_rate.note: Secondary source; the page also shows 8.06% for the same date in its history table.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Philippines, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Philippine-source interest is subject to a 20% final tax; long-term deposits (5 years or more) can be exempt under conditions; foreign currency deposit interest is taxed at 15%.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Philippines, individual income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Retail Treasury Bond interest is Philippine-source interest, taxed at the 20% final tax.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Maximum deposit insurance coverage PHP 1 million per depositor per bank, effective 15 March 2025.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BSP Circular No. 1098, Series of 2020 (ceiling on credit card interest)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Annual cap of 24% (2% a month), effective 3 November 2020, subject to BSP review every six months; later revisions to the cap could not be checked.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BSP indicators: PSE composite index 5,706 on 29 Oct 2026 vs 6,854 average in 2021; 364-day T-bill 6.58%
equity_return_low.note: Low case below the after-tax bill rate, since the PSE index is lower now than five and ten years ago.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BSP indicators: PSE composite index 5,706 on 29 Oct 2026 vs 6,854 average in 2021; 364-day T-bill 6.58% (5.3% after 20% tax)
equity_return_base.note: After-tax 1-year bill rate of about 5.3% plus a premium under 2 points, kept low because the local index has a negative 10-year price record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BSP indicators: PSE composite index and price-earnings ratio 9.9 in 2026
equity_return_high.note: High case if valuations (P/E near 10, a decade low) recover toward their long-run level.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BSP indicators: peso per US dollar averaged 49.3 in 2021 and 63.1 in October 2026
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold and a stable peso.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BSP indicators: peso per US dollar averaged 49.3 in 2021 and 63.1 in October 2026
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus peso depreciation of about 2-3% a year.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BSP indicators: peso per US dollar averaged 49.3 in 2021 and 63.1 in October 2026
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and faster peso depreciation, as in 2026.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BSP indicators: average time deposit rate 4.34% less 20% final tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank time deposits at about 4.3% less the 20% final tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BSP indicators: 91-day to 364-day T-bills 6.26-6.58%; time deposits 4.34%; 20% final tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of time deposits and Treasury bills or Retail Treasury Bonds after the 20% final tax, allowing for rates falling back from 2026 highs.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: 10-year government bond yield 8.15% less 20% final tax
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in long government bonds at about 8% (6.5% after tax).

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Insurance Commission site returned HTTP 403; no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold in the Philippines, but no published per-1,000 premium rates by age could be reached; insurers quote individually.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Searched for typical private hospital bills: no reachable published figure (PhilHealth case-rate pages were not accessible).

health_premium_table.note: No published HMO or health insurance premium table by age could be reached.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Trading Economics (PSA CPI): health inflation 5.0% in August 2026
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices rose about 5% a year in 2026; we plan with 6% for private hospital and medicine costs above headline.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Trading Economics (PSA CPI): education inflation 4.0% in June and 1.9% in July 2026
goal_inflation_education.note: Education CPI runs near headline, but private tuition rises faster, so we plan with 5%.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 70.2 for 2026 (men 67.2, women 73.2).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 8.53 (2025, World Bank), 12.6 (2040) and 25.3 (2065, populationpyramid.net/philippines/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: SSS pension from 60 if separated from work (optional), or at 65 regardless (technical retirement), with at least 120 monthly contributions. Labor Code (RA 7641): optional retirement at 60, compulsory at 65. Same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Republic Act No. 8291 (GSIS Act of 1997), Section 13 (via Lawphil)
retirement_age_government.note: Compulsory retirement at 65; optional retirement from 60 with at least 15 years of service.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BSP indicators: average time deposit rate 4.34% less 20% final tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: time deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BSP indicators: 364-day T-bill 6.58% (5.26% after 20% final tax)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the after-tax 1-year T-bill rate of about 5.3%, allowing for rates easing from 2026 highs.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: 10-year government bond yield 8.15% less 20% final tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case: laddered Retail Treasury Bonds and long government bonds after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: BSP indicators: T-bill rates, PSE index record
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix given the weak local equity record.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: BSP indicators: T-bill rates, PSE index record
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: about half equity at 7% and half safe fixed income at 4.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: BSP indicators: T-bill rates, PSE index record
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case if equities recover from decade-low valuations.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Republic Act No. 11916 (Social Pension for Indigent Senior Citizens) via Lawphil
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Indigent senior citizens receive a monthly stipend of not less than PHP 1,000 (doubled from PHP 500), paid through DSWD.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Republic Act No. 11916 (Social Pension for Indigent Senior Citizens) via Lawphil
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Senior citizens are people aged 60 and over (RA 7432 as amended); the stipend is only for seniors who qualify as indigent under DSWD's means test.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Republic Act No. 7641 (Retirement Pay Law, Labor Code Art. 302) via Lawphil
gratuity_rule.note: Where no company plan exists, employees retiring at 60-65 with at least 5 years' service get half a month's salary per year: 15 days plus 1/12 of the 13th-month pay plus 5 days' service incentive leave = 22.5 days. Daily rate taken as monthly salary / 26 working days (common practice for a six-day week).

public_pension_scheme.note: SSS is a defined-benefit pension for private, self-employed and OFW members: from 60 (separated) or 65, with 120 monthly contributions; minimum pension PHP 1,200 (10 years' credited service) or 2,400 (20 years); 13th-month pension each December; the SSS page describes no automatic inflation indexing.

savings_account.note: Peso savings accounts are standard; balances up to PHP 1 million per bank are insured by PDIC.

dps.note: Government (Pag-IBIG Fund) voluntary savings scheme with a 5-year term and flexible monthly payments; dividends declared yearly; not a bank product.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold by the Bureau of the Treasury to individuals in periodic offerings through banks; coupon set at each issue.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned weekly by the Bureau of the Treasury; individuals usually buy through banks.

equity_fund.localNameEn: UITF or mutual fund (equity index fund)
equity_fund.note: Bank-run UITFs and SEC-registered mutual funds, including PSEi index funds, are sold to retail investors.

gold.note: Gold jewellery and bullion can be bought legally from dealers.

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Commission (public assistance and complaints)
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman; the Commission handles policyholder complaints.

pensionScheme.name: Social Security System (SSS)
pensionScheme.note: Government employees are covered by GSIS (https://www.gsis.gov.ph/).

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social Pension for Indigent Senior Citizens, Department of Social Welfare and Development
